decisions.reason: An organic vegan superfood drink mix is far outside the core chemical business and lacks a dedicated product page, indicating low strategic fit and likely discontinuation.
Modular waste-to-energy plant extensions align with the firm's chemical engineering capabilities and sustainability strategy, though only mentioned on the website.
The waste oil to energy plant has its own dedicated page, signaling strong commitment and likely better market traction.
Plastic waste to fuel is strategically relevant to circular economy goals, but lower promotion suggests it may be under evaluation.
